headline_marked: MP Nazrul & first wife granted bail after suicide case settlement
headline: MP Nazrul & first wife granted bail after suicide case settlement
summary: The father of a woman who died by suicide has reached a settlement with MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, who were accused of abetting her death. The court granted bail to the first wife but did not accept the settlement.
details: MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Makshuda Islam, have been granted bail in a case related to the suicide of Nazrul's second wife, Mariyam Khatun. Mariyam's father, Md. Masum Billah, submitted a settlement agreement to the court stating he had no objection to their bail.

The settlement document, presented to the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court in Dhaka, indicated that the families are relatives and wished to maintain amicable relations. However, the court did not accept the settlement, though it granted bail to Makshuda Islam considering her age and gender.

Mariyam Khatun was found dead in a flat in the NDM building on September 20. Her father filed a case that same night accusing Gazi Nazrul Islam, his first wife Makshuda Islam, and Mariyam's uncle of abetting her suicide, alleging Mariyam had been a victim of torture.

Gazi Nazrul Islam, a Member of Parliament from Satkhira-4 constituency elected on a Jamaat-e-Islami ticket, had previously admitted that Mariyam was his second wife after a video of them together circulated on social media in July.

During the investigation, Gazi Nazrul was taken on remand twice for a total of eight days. The investigation officer stated that important information was obtained from Nazrul regarding the incident. Mariyam reportedly slept on the balcony adjacent to Nazrul's bedroom while he was living with his first wife in the NDM building.
